title: FR: Role-Based-Access-Control (RBAC)
body: Instead of just giving users full or read-only access, assign them roles with granular permissions.

comments.author: reporter

comments.author: participant8
comments.body:
RBAC ability to control access to collections by API key is very important to enterprise usage. 

It doesn't need to be fancy. It doesn't even need to be fine grained role based. A simple ACL that controls access to a collection by apikey would be a big step forward - enabling multiple dev teams to share an instance without ability to see each others content.
